summary: Backend unit/integration test of the new html_to_js_module agent tool via Agent.run_tool on a scratch project (TEST_iter8_html2js, created/deleted via API). 16/17 pass. Registration, dispatch, export-default module generation, JSON-valid string (also verified by importing the module in Node), external script/URL removal, external <a> -> '#', change card emission, create vs edit op, keep_stylesheets true/false, keep_domains, source untouched, all validation errors (js_path outside frontend/src incl. '..', non-.js, missing html, binary html, missing args) and no file written on error all work. One spec gap: only EXTERNAL <script src=http...> tags are removed; local <script src='js/x.js'> and inline <script>...</script> remain in the embedded HTML, whereas the request says to clean 'old <script> tags' and expects 'no <script> tags'. Regression: test_unknown_tool.py prints 'model calls: 2'; move_or_copy_file, clean_external_links, search_in_files OK; test_iter4_attach_tools.py 14/14 when run alone (extract_zip included). Preview builder escapes '<' in the modules JSON (\u003c), so a '</script>' inside the string will not break the preview. The live preview render was not checked (optional).

minor.issue: It reuses strip_external, which drops only external scripts (EXT_SCRIPT regex needs src=http(s)/\/\/). Inline <script>...</script> and local <script src='js/local-old.js'></script> stay in the exported HTML. This breaks the requirement to remove old <script> tags. They won't run under dangerouslySetInnerHTML, but they are dead weight and do not match the tool description. Fix: in _html_to_js_module, after strip_external, run re.sub(r'<script\b[^>]*>.*?</script\s*>', '', cleaned, flags=re.I|re.S) plus self-closing/orphan <script ...> tags, and add the count to stats/the message (optionally behind a keep_inline_scripts flag).

action_items: Strip ALL <script> tags (inline and local, not just external) in Agent._html_to_js_module, and report the count in the OK message and the change card. Then re-run tests/test_iter8_html_to_js_module.py::TestConvert::test_no_script_tags.
critical_code_review_comments: _html_to_js_module message says '{stats['scripts']} scripts externos removidos' — accurate today, but once all scripts are stripped update the wording.
The tool also passes <base>, <meta http-equiv=refresh>, and inline on* handlers (onclick=...) through. Not a blocker; consider stripping on* attributes too, since React will inject them raw.
agent.py is 729 lines (>700). Consider moving the HTML/file server tools (strip_external, _move_copy, _clean_links, _extract_zip, _html_to_js_module) into a separate module.

Test infra: running several test modules in one pytest process fails because each module creates its own asyncio loop while Motor's db client binds to the first. pytest.ini also uses xdist --dist loadscope, which splits classes of one module across workers (module fixtures are then duplicated per worker). Run these unit files with -o addopts='' one file at a time.
